# Browse the questions

1,988 questions, one row each, sorted into eighteen priorities. Each page below lists the questions under one priority, split by where the question came from: a candidate who sat the interview, a compiled report, or a study bank. That split is the point. The three sources disagree, and a page that merged them would hide it.

**A count here is a count of questions that were written down.** It is not the chance a room asks one. Read [the report](../REPORT.md) before you read a number off this page.

## What the question asks you to do

| Task | Firm questions | Of which from a sitting |
|---|---|---|
| explain | 922 | 27 |
| design | 463 | 5 |
| implement | 143 | 0 |
| diagnose | 72 | 2 |
| defend | 47 | 3 |
| evaluate | 26 | 0 |

`explain` means define or compare. It was added to the list before labeling, because "what is a KV cache?" is not a design question and forcing it into `design` would have inflated design.
